property_summary: For any address input, calling SetLogFile(x) on the correct contract only sets the LogFile address (and does not change MinSum); the mutant instead changes MinSum (casting the address to uint), so there exists some address input for which MinSum differs after the call — the reference keeps MinSum unchanged while the mutant may set it to uint(uint160(x)).
change_summary: Replace the assignment to LogFile with a call to SetMinSum, so SetLogFile no longer sets the log address but instead calls SetMinSum with the provided address cast to uint, changing observable state after the call.
